zh: 油瓶可重新点燃火柴，暂时提升攻击强度，并在存盘点补满。
en: Oil bottles relight the match, briefly strengthen attacks and refill at save points.

zh: 继续前进会遭遇园丁，随后进入首领战。
en: Continue forward to encounter the Groundskeeper and begin the boss fight.

zh: 取得猎人的吊坠，可延长治疗判定时间。
en: Obtain the Hunter's Pendant to extend the healing timing window.

zh: 起点位于大型头骨内部，从右侧出口离开，继续前往夜之庭园。
en: Start inside the large skull. Leave through the right exit and continue toward Night Garden.

zh: 起点位于大型头骨内部，右侧有出口。离开头骨后，继续进入夜之庭园。
en: Leave the large skull through the exit on the right and continue into Night Garden.

zh: 离开起点后进入夜之庭园，接着探索庭园前段。
en: After leaving the starting area, enter Night Garden and explore its early rooms.

zh: 后续返回起点，沿下行水道继续探索。
en: Later, return to the starting area and follow the water channel downward.

zh: 庭园前段可以找到帐篷，在这里保存游戏并进入营帐菜单。
en: Find the tent in the early garden section to save your game and open the tent menu.

zh: 进入夜之庭园后，先熟悉存档与油瓶的使用，再继续前往园丁所在区域。油瓶可重新点燃火柴、暂时强化攻击，并在存盘点补满。
en: In Night Garden, learn to save and use oil bottles before continuing to the Groundskeeper. Oil bottles relight the match, temporarily strengthen attacks and refill at save points.

zh: 油瓶可以重新点燃火柴，并暂时强化攻击。到达存盘点后可补充油瓶，继续探索前先检查补给。
en: Oil bottles relight the match and briefly strengthen attacks. Refill them at save points before continuing your exploration.

zh: 继续经过泡泡与高处平台，注意检查上下层的探索路线。
en: Continue through the bubbles and higher platforms, checking routes on both levels.

zh: 途中可以取得饰物点。注意区分饰物点、心形罐子与高处亮点；这里的拾取并不是猎人的吊坠。
en: Pick up the trinket slot along the route. Do not confuse it with the heart-shaped container, the higher glowing object or the Hunter's Pendant.

zh: 油瓶教学之后会遭遇园丁，准备好补给再进入首领战。
en: The Groundskeeper encounter follows the oil-bottle tutorial. Check your supplies before the fight.

zh: 园丁周围会出现粉色花瓣状弹幕，战斗时注意弹幕的覆盖范围。
en: Pink petal-shaped projectiles appear around the Groundskeeper. Watch their coverage during the fight.

zh: 园丁上方会出现粉色花瓣形弹幕，注意观察弹幕方向。
en: Pink petal-shaped projectiles appear above the Groundskeeper. Watch their direction.

match: 在 P1 的推进片段中，油瓶教学
zh: 夜之庭园前段完成油瓶教学后，继续推进便会遭遇园丁。
en: Continue through Night Garden after the oil-bottle tutorial to encounter the Groundskeeper.

zh: 击败园丁后继续前往猎人小屋，展开后续探索。
en: After defeating the Groundskeeper, continue toward Hunter's Cabin for the next exploration segment.

zh: 战斗结束后继续前往猎人小屋。
en: After the fight, continue toward Hunter's Cabin.

zh: 小屋段落中会遇到拾荒者，并学习投掷焰瓶后在空中击打的操作。后续可取得猎人的吊坠，其作用是延长治疗判定时间。
en: Meet Looter in the cabin segment and learn to throw a flaming vessel and strike it in midair. Later, obtain the Hunter's Pendant, which extends the healing timing window.

zh: 进入小屋段落后与拾荒者交谈，继续学习焰瓶投掷。
en: Speak with Looter in the cabin segment and continue to the flaming-vessel tutorial.

zh: 投掷焰瓶后，可以在空中击打并引爆。练习这一操作，再继续探索小屋。
en: Throw a flaming vessel, then strike it in midair to detonate it. Practise the action before continuing through the cabin.

zh: 小屋内有悬笼、泡泡与尖刺交错的探索路段，留意安全落脚点和高低差。
en: The cabin route combines hanging cages, bubbles and spikes. Watch for safe footholds and changes in elevation.

zh: 取得猎人的吊坠，其作用是延长治疗判定时间，不是增加生命上限。
en: Obtain the Hunter's Pendant. It extends the healing timing window rather than increasing maximum health.

zh: 打开地图核对已经探索的房间与支路，继续检查遗漏的路线。
en: Open the map to review explored rooms and branches, then check routes you may have missed.

zh: 完成小屋教学后返回庭园，再检查紫色障碍附近的路线。
en: After the cabin tutorial, return to the garden and inspect the route near the purple obstacle.
